prompt.en: What joins Prince Edward Island to mainland Canada?
prompt.fr: Qu'est-ce qui relie l'Île-du-Prince-Édouard au reste du Canada continental?

explanation.en: The Confederation Bridge carries traffic between the island and the mainland. It is one of the longest bridges of its kind anywhere in the world.
explanation.fr: Le pont de la Confédération fait passer la circulation entre l'île et le continent. C'est l'un des plus longs ponts de ce type au monde.

source.quote: P.E.I. is the birthplace of Confederation, connected to mainland Canada by one of the longest continuous multispan bridges in the world, the Confederation Bridge.

verification.evidence: P.E.I. is the birthplace of Confederation, connected to mainland Canada by one of the longest continuous multispan bridges in the world, the Confederation Bridge.
